scopeIntroduction: Five displays: one large, two medium and two small. Smart home and network are itemised separately.

items.name: SmartHome Server package (smart home controller with Zigbee/Thread radio)
Smart light switch (physical button, smart function)
UniFi U7 Lite Wi-Fi 7 ceiling access point (U7-Lite)

dashboards: 15.6" and 10" displays: 1 main dashboard (at-a-glance view of the home); NeoPlan3D interactive 3D floor plan, on the 15.6" display; 1 area-based dashboard.
4" displays: 1 Home Assistant dashboard for that display's area; 1 scene control dashboard.
integrations: Voice assistant with Chinese spoken-language understanding
Client network and separate IoT network setup
automations: 10 automations, including: Away scene — lights turn on and off at random when no one is home; I'm home / I'm leaving scenes; Movie scene; Night-time sentry mode.

terms: This quote includes up to 50 hours of installation and setup. Any work beyond 50 hours is charged separately at $180.00 per hour.
Integrations marked 'best effort' depend on the device and manufacturer supporting Home Assistant. If a device can't be integrated reliably, it is not charged as extra hours.
Home Assistant remote access and cloud backup run on a Nabu Casa subscription, paid by the client directly.
The network (Section B) is priced separately and can be accepted on its own.
Prices are valid for 30 days. Hardware prices may change if the supplier's prices change before order.
hyperCare: 60 days of support and bug fixes within agreed scope for the system as delivered; no feature additions.
warranty: 2 years, hardware only. Installation work and recoding require a separate quote.
signing: Signing integration deferred. Acceptance lines are informational; no signing has occurred.
